subject: multivariate priors for a joint model

messages.author: a7771da433f6194e
messages.subject: multivariate priors for a joint model
parts:
Hi,

I'm fitting a joint pp model using a spde model for each of the fields of the following form and using the 'copy' feature similar to the preferential sampling example in the spde tutorial,

c1~b01 + z1(s)
c2~b02 + z2(s)
c3~b03 + z3(s)
eta(pp)~ beta1 z1(s) + beta2 z2(s) + beta3 z3(s) + z4(s)

however I was wondering if there was a way to use a mvn prior for the beta_i s/or telling INLA how much ``structure'' to attribute to each field?

Many Thanks
